# Dubai Life

> Dubai Life (https://mydubailife.app) is a free online life simulation set in Dubai, played in the browser on phone or computer. Players create an avatar, rent a home, get a job, ride the Dubai Metro and taxis, shop at Dubai Mall, play multiplayer games and make real friends.

The app's name is "Dubai Life"; mydubailife.app is its web address. Social accounts: @dubailifeapp on X, Instagram, TikTok and LinkedIn.

## Pages

- [What is Dubai Life?](https://mydubailife.app/about): what you can do, places, games and FAQ
- [Explore the Dubai map](https://mydubailife.app/explore): the city map with landmarks, venues and metro stations
- [The Dubai Mall](https://mydubailife.app/place/dubai-mall): one of the places you can go inside
- [Dubai Academic City](https://mydubailife.app/academics): courses and skills
- [Dubai scam check](https://mydubailife.app/scam-check): a 30-second quiz on common Dubai scams
- [Advertise in Dubai Life](https://mydubailife.app/business): billboards and business listings
- [Sitemap](https://mydubailife.app/sitemap.xml): every public page
